universe.name: Precision Carved Wood Automata
universe.why: The foundation of AI is physical manufacturing, but driven by intricate invisible architecture. Wood automata perfectly captures the physical precision of hardware and the clockwork logic of code.
universe.pacing: Patient, mechanical, and rhythmic. Like a well-oiled machine ticking perfectly.
universe.signature_shot: A carved wooden microchip pulsing with inlaid green resin, sliding perfectly down a brass rail.
universe.medium_break: The wooden penguin touches wet varnish on an empty chip mold and leaves a flipper-print.
universe.look_bible: Precision carved marquetry and gear-driven wood automata. Medium: polished walnut, maple cream, brass pins, inlaid glowing green resin. Warm, directional workshop lighting creating deep shadows. Shallow depth of field macro photography. Texture: visible wood grain, sawdust motes in the air, shiny brass. Motion: stop-motion mechanical stepping, sliding wooden parts clicking on brass rails. No text or numbers.
universe.penguin_render: A carved, painted wooden toy penguin, egg-shaped, with black painted back, white belly, orange painted feet, and three thin brass wires for head feathers.
universe.music: Plucky cello pizzicato, ticking clockwork percussion, and warm woodwinds.

penguin.arc: Wanders the workshop, ruins a fresh varnish job, and later tries to fly off a high wooden ledge only to tumble into sawdust.

shots.cue: One man in a leather jacket
shots.motion: Camera pulls back 30% smoothly as the brass gear beneath the pedestal begins to rotate.
Camera tilts down 20% as the spinning gear pushes the wooden microchips forward along the rail.
Camera pushes in 20% on the wooden chips as the green inlaid resin lines illuminate.
Camera pushes in 30% as brass coins fall into the right pan, tipping the scale heavily.
Camera tilts down 30% to the workbench below, revealing the penguin ruining the varnish.
Camera pans right 30% following the bench to reveal the brass conveyor belt carrying raw wood blocks.
Camera pushes in 20% as the mechanical brass chisel stamps rapidly down onto the wood block.
Camera pans up 30% as complex white lines rapidly draw the castle wall snapping shut.
Camera pushes in 20% as the new drafted chip attempts to slide under the wall.
Camera drifts right 20% as the drawn gears clash and aggressively lock up.
Camera pulls back 20% as the giant red 'X' aggressively strikes through the new chip.
Camera tilts up 30% from the sliding chips to reveal the penguin on the ledge.
Camera pushes in 20% as the penguin tumbles clumsily off the ledge.
Camera pans left 30% to land solemnly on the empty display hook holding only the wooden jacket.
